description: This file defines UI theming and appearance-related utilities for a chat application, including color schemes, background styles, and platform-specific image handling.

classes.name: OpenClawChatTheme
classes.description: Enumeration providing static properties and methods for theming chat UI components based on platform and appearance.

classes.name: OpenClawPlatformImageFactory
classes.description: Enumeration with a static method to create platform-specific images from a custom image type.

methods.name: resolvedAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Returns a NSColor for the assistant bubble based on the appearance, handling dark and light modes.

methods.name: resolvedOnboardingAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Returns a NSColor for onboarding assistant bubble based on appearance.

methods.name: image(_ image:)
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific Image from a custom OpenClawPlatformImage.
